summary: Multi-line text that grows with its content up to a maximum, with an optional character count. Give it a label prop or place it inside a Field.

p.label: Change summary
p.hint: Reviewers read this first. Say what changed and why.

whenToUse: Free text longer than one line: pull request summaries, release notes, review comments.
showCount with maxLength when there is a hard limit.
whenNotToUse: A short single value: use Input.
Structured content (lists of tokens, key-value pairs): use dedicated fields.

dos.title: Size it for the expected answer
dos.text: rows sets the starting height; autosize grows it, so short boxes do not hide long answers.

donts.title: Hiding the limit until it is hit
donts.text: Show the count while typing so users can edit before the error.

accessibility: Native textarea through Base UI Field: label, description and error are wired for you.
Focus shows a 2px signal edge; invalid sets aria-invalid and a danger edge with a text error.
The visual counter is hidden from screen readers to avoid announcing every keystroke; maxLength is enforced natively.
On touch screens the text is 17px so iOS does not zoom on focus.
contentGuidelines: Placeholder shows an example answer, not instructions.
Use the hint for what makes a good answer.
